title: Has anyone tried using the new image to 3d asset generator by microsoft, if yes then how was it ???
author: DifferentCost5178

comments.author: GigaTerra
comments.body: What I am learning with AI tools is to give them time. Right now Trellis 2 is generating better models than Rodin Gen 2, however these AI seam to decrease in quality after it gets hyped. I don't know if this is because servers are overworked, or if they are using more resources during launch but it has happened too many times now.

replies.author: Smilysis
replies.body:
Hm... The quality decreases only happens on cloud service only AI models

You can run Trellis 2 locally on your computer

comments.author: RemarkableGuidance44
comments.body:
Yes, its very good. However for you to get the detail they show you need at least 64G of VRAM otherwise it will lower the detail by x amount of Vram. Example a 32G card can only do 1152 res. 

I started to use it over Rodin and Hun because these are my models and I know they are not being trained on. I even paid for the Tencent 3d Gen for Enterprise. But I dont need that now. 

Thing is I am a 3d artist and I use AI to generate the base mesh for reference and build from there.

replies.author: No-Dot-6573
replies.body: Can you use multiple gpus? For example a 5090 and a 4090 to generate with 56gb of vram?

replies.author: Crierlon
replies.body: How did you get it ready for sculpting? Thing always comes in with massive holes.

replies.author: RemarkableGuidance44
replies.body: I rebuilt it in Blender or Plasticity

replies.author: TheMisterPirate
replies.body: when you say 1152 res you mean the texture size? what about polycount, are there controls for that?

comments.author: erebusman
comments.body: Well my experience is I went and tried it out on an image I had previously used with other models (rodin, trellis 1) and it immediately said I was exceeding my daily usage even though I haven't been to trellis in over a month haha.

replies.author: DifferentCost5178
replies.body: so true, even i have experienced this
